STEM: Match each change with what happens at the next dbt run of the model. Use each effect once.
  L1. The SQL of a table model changes (it stays materialized='table').
  L2. A view model is changed to materialized='ephemeral'.
  L3. An ephemeral model is changed to materialized='table'.
  L4. An existing incremental model runs with --full-refresh.
  L5. An existing incremental model runs normally.
  Ra. The rows already stored are kept; only the rows selected by the is_incremental() filter are written into the table.
  Rb. dbt builds the complete new result under a temporary name (__dbt_tmp) and then swaps it with the old table.
  Rc. The old view stays in the warehouse but is no longer updated; the children now contain the model's SQL as a CTE.
  Rd. A new table appears, and the children now select from it instead of using a CTE.
  Re. is_incremental() is false: the filter is skipped and the whole table is rebuilt from scratch.
